config.compaction.excludeMessages.descri: Number of most recent literal messages preserved verbatim during session compaction.

config.agents.timeoutMs.description: Maximum execution timeout in milliseconds for a single local agent run.
config.agents.custom.description: Additional custom local agent CLIs to expose in Tarot IDE.
